events.title: PostReady: PR #651 — Create tab: ideas dropdown + compact light Pro Prompt strip
events.description: Added an ideas dropdown to the Create tab and a compact light-mode Pro Prompt strip, improving the content creation workflow with quick-access prompt inspiration.

events.title: PostReady: PR #652 — Create tab: tighten starting-point row + Pro Prompt strip
events.description: Tightened the starting-point row and Pro Prompt strip on the Create tab, refining the layout as part of the ongoing Create area redesign.

events.title: PostReady: PR #653 — Create tab: Pro Prompt centered + Brand options up + wider form
events.description: Centered the Pro Prompt button below the post preview, moved Brand options up in the hierarchy, and widened the creation form for a cleaner desktop layout.

events.title: PostReady: PR #654 — Create tab: Brand options under the post preview (desktop final)
events.description: Moved Brand options to sit directly under the post preview on desktop, completing the Create tab layout redesign series and matching the owner mockup.

events.title: PostReady: PR #658 — fix(video): end card now actually appends
events.description: Fixed a bug where the branded end card was not being concatenated to the final video output.

events.title: PostReady: PR #660 — fix(video): end card as real MP4 clip (A/V aligned) + fade-in
events.description: Renders the end card as a proper MP4 with silent audio track and 0.5s fade-in, resolving A/V stream mismatches that caused players to stall.

events.title: PostReady: PR #661 — Multi-scene becomes "Animated scenes"
events.description: Rebranded multi-scene video to "Animated scenes" and forced animated art style throughout the pipeline. People are welcome as animated characters.

events.title: PostReady: PR #662 — fix(video): actually force animated frames
events.description: Fixed animated-scene frames still rendering as photoreal despite the Animated scenes rebrand. Animated art-direction is now correctly enforced through the frame-generation pipeline.

events.title: PostReady: PR #713 — feat(pivot): hide customer video behind kill-switch (epic #663 A1)
events.description: Strategic product pivot: customer video gated behind NEXT_PUBLIC_VIDEO_ENABLED kill-switch (default OFF). All video entry points hidden without deleting code — fully reversible. Video engine preserved for future Bring to Life feature.

events.title: PostReady: PR #752 — feat(carousel): Carousel Creator editor on the Create tab (epic #663 workstream D)
events.description: First build of the Carousel Creator — a horizontal-filmstrip editor living on the Create page as a new "Create Carousel" tab. Filmstrip with drag-to-reorder, per-card delete, Add card menu (AI / text / photo / CTA / duplicate / blank), editable card canvas, and inspector panel.
